en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Ubeys Bin Hisham, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Clean their pens and wipe their dust (from their fur)’.
en.sarwar: 3. Abu Ali al-Ash‘ariy has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Ali from ‘Ubays ibn Hisham from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘
You must clean the fold of the sheep and dust from them.’”
